_comment: Oversized is the period cue here. A half-zip fleece is still sold today; the 2003 version is two sizes larger than a modern one would be cut, which is why the negatives push against a fitted shape rather than against the garment itself. REWORDED 2026-09-05 to name what is worn below it, so the frame is dressed to the ankle rather than leaving the model to invent the bottom half -- an unstated garment is the one place this menu was letting a modern silhouette in.
label: Zip-up fleece
wardrobe: an oversized half-zip fleece pullover in marl grey, the zip pulled up to the collar, worn over a plain t-shirt with stonewashed straight-leg jeans
